behavior_checks: Chat Completions SSE bytes are preserved and provider usage is recorded.
Transient WebSocket handshake retries are bounded to three attempts before any model frame is sent.
Model request budgets count submitted model frames, not handshake attempts.
Failed, incomplete, cancelled, or interrupted WebSocket requests record zero estimated savings.
An interrupted request is recorded without upstream error text and is not automatically replayed; a new client connection can proceed.
The x-utk-session-id header is not forwarded to the upstream WebSocket.
scope_note: Protocol-level offline behavior evidence only. Selected fixed-upstream tests do not imply full feature parity or real Codex/Hermes client acceptance; those remain separately scoped.
